description: Gets a SaaS vendor's Google Workspace integration through Google OAuth app verification and onto the Google Workspace Marketplace - Gmail, Drive and Chat scope choice, the CASA security assessment, listing review, admin domain-wide install, changes after listing. Use whenever a vendor mentions publishing a Workspace add-on, Gmail or Drive integration, or Chat app, the "Google hasn't verified this app" screen, the 100-user cap, CASA, restricted scopes, or a rejected Marketplace review. Do NOT use for listing copy (use samber/developer-platform-skills@integration-listing-optimization), for your own API's OAuth (use samber/developer-platform-skills@oauth2-provider-design), or for internal-only apps.
